implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit transport, dynamic pre-SOF table ownership, SOF DQT ownership transfer, first-SOS DQT release, actual-only coefficient planes, exact current Huffman payloads, render-only quantization widening, packed four-bit progression state and validated-EOI final-ready compaction

requiredInvariants: All v13 transport, dynamic pre-frame ownership, SOF DQT transfer, source semantics, actual coefficient geometry, dynamic Huffman, render-only quantization widening, preview backing, restart and EOI-compaction invariants remain unchanged.

The qualified scan domain permits successive-low values only from 0 through 13. Together with the unseen state this is exactly 15 progression states, so every entry fits in four bits; nibble 0xE remains invalid and 0xF encodes unseen.
Three components times 64 progression entries occupy exactly 96 bytes. Persistent base fixed state is exactly 288 bytes: 192 bytes of bound UInt8 quantization plus 96 bytes of packed progression.

Progression validation, scan completion update, block-smoothing usefulness, smoothing coefficient estimation and final EOI progression validation all use the packed accessor rather than a raw Int8 buffer.

The package-only progression codec round-trips unseen and all values 0 through 13, rejects value 14 and rejects reserved nibble 0xE. The retained fixture itself reaches successive-low 2, so the explicit codec gate covers the otherwise unobserved high semantic states.

Compared with v13, persistent state decreases by exactly 96 bytes and render scratch is unchanged. Therefore maximum retained authority and every current decoder-active retained charge decrease by 96 bytes, and all three current render-dominated operation peaks also decrease by exactly 96 bytes.

The tiny source has persistentBaseStateBytes 1568, maximum persistentStateBytes 3744, renderScratchBytes 2880 and totalStateBytes 6624. Its final-ready retained value remains 897 bytes, maximum retained authority is 5055 bytes and operation peak is 7935 bytes.
The 576x576 source has maximum retained authority 998206 bytes, final-ready retained 995328 bytes and operation peak 2010750 bytes.
The restart64 source has maximum retained authority 15166 bytes, final-ready retained 12288 bytes and operation peak 30334 bytes.

Pre-frame and frame-q high-water remain 128 bytes for all retained sources; final/high-water DHT values remain 90/95, 98/169 and 89/135 bytes. Progression packing must not perturb table authority, entropy rollback, pixels or output lifetime.

This profile does not qualify malloc headers, allocator size classes, Swift object/pointer fields, physical RSS, non-JFIF semantics, embedded ICC, other sampling modes or perceptual reconstruction quality.
